description: Expense management screens: home dashboard, add/edit expense, expense list, expense detail. Updates home_screen.dart to show real data from expense_provider with summary cards (total spent, expense count, top category), bar chart using fl_chart for weekly spending, recent expenses list, FAB to add expense, bottom navigation. Creates add_expense_screen.dart with amount input, currency selector dropdown, category picker, date picker, note field, optional receipt image upload with image_picker. Creates expense_list_screen.dart with filter chips (date ranges, categories), search bar, grouped list by date, swipe-to-delete. Creates expense_detail_screen.dart showing all expense info, receipt image if present, edit/delete actions.
steps: Create lib/widgets/common/currency_selector.dart: reusable dropdown showing currency code and symbol, uses currencies from app_constants
Create lib/widgets/common/category_picker.dart: GridView showing category icons with colors, allows selection, highlights selected
Create lib/widgets/common/date_filter_chips.dart: horizontal scrollable chips for Today, This Week, This Month, This Year, Custom (opens date range picker)
Create lib/widgets/common/expense_card.dart: reusable Card widget displaying expense with category icon, amount with currency, date, note preview, tap to open detail

Create lib/screens/expense/add_expense_screen.dart: Scaffold with form, TextFormField for amount (number keyboard), CurrencySelector, CategoryPicker (opens bottom sheet), DatePicker (defaults to today), TextField for note, ImagePicker button for receipt (shows thumbnail after selection), Save button calls expense_provider.addExpense, shows loading, handles errors, pops on success
Create lib/screens/expense/edit_expense_screen.dart: same as add_expense but pre-fills fields from Expense object passed as argument, Save button calls expense_provider.updateExpense

Create lib/screens/expense/expense_list_screen.dart: AppBar with search TextField, DateFilterChips below AppBar, category filter icon button (opens bottom sheet with category list), StreamBuilder or Consumer for expense_provider.expenses, ListView.builder grouped by date headers, each item is ExpenseCard, FloatingActionButton to add expense, empty state when no expenses

Create lib/screens/expense/expense_detail_screen.dart: shows all expense fields, receipt image if present (cached_network_image with zoom on tap), Edit FAB, Delete action in AppBar menu (shows confirmation dialog), back button

Update lib/screens/home/home_screen.dart: replace hardcoded data with Consumer<ExpenseProvider>, summary row with 3 cards (total spent this month, expense count, top category), BarChart from fl_chart showing last 7 days spending, 'Recent Expenses' section with ListView of last 5 expenses as ExpenseCards, bottom navigation with 5 items (Home, Expenses, Add [FAB], Reports, Profile), navigate to respective screens
Create lib/widgets/common/summary_card.dart: reusable Card with title, value, icon, used in home dashboard
Create lib/widgets/common/spending_chart.dart: wraps fl_chart BarChart, takes List<Expense>, groups by day, shows last 7 days, formatted amounts on Y-axis
acceptance_criteria: Home dashboard displays correct totals from expense_provider
Chart shows spending for last 7 days with correct values
Add expense saves to Firestore and updates UI immediately
Edit expense updates existing expense correctly
Receipt image uploads to Firebase Storage and URL saves to expense
Expense list filters work (date range, category, search)
Expense detail shows all info including image
Delete expense removes from Firestore and updates UI
verification: Run 'flutter analyze' and confirm zero issues
Login and navigate to home - verify dashboard loads
Tap Add FAB, fill form, save - verify expense appears
Tap expense card - verify detail screen shows
Apply date/category filters - verify list updates
Upload receipt image - verify it appears in detail screen
Test bottom navigation - verify all tabs work
